personality.description: This person tends to keep careful routines, make detailed plans, and double-check work before acting, while still being willing to try new ideas if they seem practical and safe. In daily life, they are likely to be considerate and cooperative, often smoothing over tension and looking for ways to support others. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually feel the conflict strongly, worry about the consequences, and try to choose the option that protects fairness and minimizes harm to everyone involved. In group discussions, they speak thoughtfully, listen attentively, and often use a calm, measured tone, though they may become hesitant or overly cautious if the conversation turns contentious.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
